+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: 'SK-5: SkillsGraph read endpoint (skills, skill(name:)) on the GraphQL toolkit'
+---
+## What
+Add `SkillsGraph`, the `skills` GraphQL endpoint (SK-5 in TestudoApp/features/packages/foundationmodels-skills.md:53), under the shared conventions EXTRAS-9 (TestudoApp/features/packages/foundationmodels-extras.md:91, decision D115). Read side only; the tool wiring and the `changes` subscription are separate tasks.
+
+## Shape (EXTRAS-9)
+- `SkillsGraph: GraphQLEndpoint`, `name = "skills"`, `version = "1"`, `scope = .sessionFolder` (rule 1, 3). The registry a session builds in FoundationModelsACPAgent `ToolCatalog`/`SessionSetup` already comes from the dotfolder stack of the session's cwd, so one endpoint per registry is one endpoint per folder.
+- Engine: toolkit only (rule 2) — `GraphQLRunContext`, `addToolkitScalars()`, `respond`/`subscribe`, `GraphQLNameRules` with this package's alias tables. No direct `GraphQL`/`Graphiti` pin. Bump the `FoundationModelsExtras` resolution to main ≥ 6670bc0.
+- Queries (rule 5): flat root fields `skills: [Skill!]!` and `skill(name: String!): Skill` (null when no such skill, never an error).
+- `Skill` (rule 6): `id: ID!` (= the catalog id / name), `name`, `description`, `parameters: [String!]!`, `source` (layer/provenance), `enabled`/model-visible flag. The endpoint lists **all** skills of the catalog, including ones with `enabled: false`, so the Settings manager and pickers (APP-16) can show them; the model-visible filter stays a tool concern.
+- No mutations (D84, rule 7 N/A). No content in the endpoint beyond metadata unless APP-16 asks for the body.
+- Alias tables (D86): e.g. `listSkills`/`getSkill`, `skill(id:)` → `skill(name:)` if the toolkit supports argument aliases.
+- Errors: a package `CodedError` only if a skills-specific code exists; otherwise toolkit codes (`NOT_FOUND`) only.
+
+## Reference
+FoundationModelsACPAgent/Sources/FoundationModelsACPAgent/Settings/SettingsGraph.swift, SettingsGraphSchema.swift and Tests/.../SettingsGraphTests.swift.
+
+## Acceptance criteria (rule 11)
+- [ ] `GraphQLSchemaGolden` test of the SDL
+- [ ] `GraphQLSchemaDescriptions.undescribed` is empty
+- [ ] `GraphQLEndpointConformance.problems` empty with an alias probe; the rule-9 (`changes`/`cursor`) check is listed as an exception naming the subscription task
+- [ ] `skill(name:)` on a missing skill returns `null`
+- [ ] Disabled skills appear in `skills` with `enabled: false`
+- [ ] `swift build` and `swift test` green #sk-5 #graphql
\ No newline at end of file

+    - Registry: each catalog generation now holds `catalog` (on), `disabled` (off), `diagnostics` in a private `CatalogGeneration`. A skill that is off is validated quietly (no diagnostics, same as before) and goes to `disabled`; every existing surface still reads only `catalog`, so `metadata()`, the tool, search, preload, `/` menu and `call` are unchanged. New public `SkillsRegistry.records() -> [SkillRecord]` (id, rendered description, parameter placeholders, `layer: DotfolderStack.Source`, `marketplace`, `isEnabled`), sorted by id. `metadata()` and `records()` share the new private `renderedDescription(entry:)` / `parameterSummaries(entry:)`.
